content:
sam-sales: Heads-up: Meridian Group wants a 10-business-day POC. Requirements summary: Okta IdP-initiated SAML, two ACS endpoints (web + worker), assertion must include `roles` claim and two audience URIs (https://meridian.app/web, https://meridian.app/worker). They also require SCIM group->role mapping with a custom extension attribute, DNS TXT domain verification, and clarity on Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Can SE own the setup?

liam-se: Happy to own. Quick questions: will they push SCIM deltas or pull? Frequency? Also confirm worker ACS expects POST and accepts RelayState.

sam-sales: Buyer says Okta will do nightly full sync + delta pushes during business hours (~every 4 minutes) for ~180 users in POC. Worker ACS must accept POST and RelayState.

nina-sec: Security checklist items: confirm SAML cert rollover process (we support overlapping certs), ability to sign assertions with JWS if requested, KMS options for Dedicated, encryption-at-rest details, and SCIM audit retention (Hosted default 90 days; enterprise can extend). Please include DPA and SOC2 links in the kickoff pack.

sysbot: POC env provisioned: `poc-meridian-2026`. URL: https://poc.redwood.internal/meridian. Namespace: poc-meridian. Admin contact sam-sales@redwood.com. Temporary SCIM rate bump enabled for POC window.

paul-fin: Pricing note: SCIM control-plane ops not billed separately on Hosted for small POCs. Token usage billed as normal. For projected production (10k MAUs, ~1.8M tokens/day) we recommend Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency and lower effective per-token cost. I'll draft a Hosted vs Dedicated estimate.

liam-se: Implementation notes: we map SCIM extension `urn:mrdn:scim:ext:1.0:roleBind` -> `roles` claim in SAML/JWT. If Okta metadata doesn't list both audiences we can either add two SP entries or accept an audience override on the SP. For IdP-initiated with multiple audiences, ensure both AudienceRestriction elements are present or provide explicit audience values.

sam-sales: Buyer asked: any onboarding fees for domain TXT verification? They also asked about SCIM throttling behavior if deltas come every 4m and spike to 600 ops/hour.

paul-fin: No onboarding fee for DNS TXT verification. SCIM throttling: Hosted can handle short spikes; sustained high-frequency deltas at production scale are better served on Dedicated. For the POC we can keep temporary higher limits and monitor.metrics. I'll include the delta in the quote.

nina-sec: Action items:
- sam-sales: get Okta metadata XML and publish DNS TXT value to buyer
- liam-se: prepare SP config docs for multi-audience SAML + SCIM mapping guide
- paul-fin: provide a short cost comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated) with example numbers for 1.8M tokens/day
- nina-sec: upload DPA/SOC2/cert-rollover docs to the POC workspace
Target kickoff: Thursday 10:00 PT (48 hours).

sam-sales: On it, adding buyer tech lead to invite now. :thumbsup:
